title: Share local-track-id resolution across mergers instead of re-deriving it per merger
rule: Evans (invariant re-derived, not enforced in one place) — needs full merger source read to confirm behavioral divergence

evidence.quote: 'stage_definitions with a remote track_id bind to the local mirror track',

why: tutored_mirror_projection_inputs_test.dart (4 test cases) and study_day_config_sync_test.dart (2 more 'Bug 3' cases) together needed 6 separate test cases to pin the same 'remote track_id → local mirror track_id' remap across StageDefinitionMerger, GoalMerger, StudyDayConfigMerger and GamificationSettingsMerger. grep confirms goal_merger.dart:57, gamification_settings_merger.dart:124 and study_day_config_merger.dart:56 each call `trackDao.getTrackByProfileAndCurriculum` directly instead of routing through the one shared `DriftMergeStore._resolveLocalTrackId` helper that already exists for this exact purpose. study_day_config_sync_test.dart shows StudyDayConfigMerger SKIPPING a row when no local track exists, which looks like different fallback semantics than _resolveLocalTrackId's `local?.id ?? fallbackTrackId` (falls back to the stale remote id rather than skipping) — if that divergence is real, a future fix to one merger's skip/fallback rule will not propagate to the others. Confirming this needs reading goal_merger.dart, gamification_settings_merger.dart, study_day_config_merger.dart and stage_definition_merger.dart in full, which are outside this batch's file list.
recommendation: Route every child-row merger's local-track resolution through DriftMergeStore._resolveLocalTrackId (or one shared helper), and add one test proving the fallback/skip behavior is identical across all mergers when no local track exists.
acceptance_criteria: goal_merger.dart, gamification_settings_merger.dart and study_day_config_merger.dart resolve the local track id through the same shared helper as drift_merge_store.dart's other call sites
a single test (or shared test helper) proves identical skip/fallback behavior across all child-row mergers when the local track is missing

corrections: Raising confidence SUSPECTED→CONFIRMED and severity P3→P2 on new cited evidence: goals.dart:16 and stage_definitions.dart:24 both carry the same unguarded FK into curriculum_tracks; user_database.dart:176 confirms PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; merge_router.dart:55 calls merger.merge with no try/catch; goal_dao.dart's upsertGoalByTrack does an unguarded insert. gamification_settings_merger.dart:118-121's own comment ('tutored_pull_error / tutored_listener_merge_error') proves this exact FK-crash class was already hit and fixed for ONE merger but not for Goal/StageDefinition, which still route through the unguarded fallback. This is a real, documented-elsewhere bug class with unaddressed exposure, not just DRY debt — concrete cost, P2 is warranted (not P1: reachability depends on pull/merge cross-channel ordering guarantees I could not fully verify, so not claiming a live production defect).
